tagline: 理光取景器相机，2001 年发布
description: 理光于2001年推出的取景器相机。配备Ricoh 30mm F7。快门速度1/60 and 1/125 sec. Self timer.。使用100 to 400 ISO。Fixed focus, 1.2m - infinity。

specs.闪光灯: Fill-in flash, electronic activates automatically in dim light with Red-Eye reduction.
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh my-1 is an ultra compact fully automatic 35mm point and shoot camera produced in 2001.
